# PLAN — iteration 2

## Current state assessment

Iteration 1 was accepted as timing progress: routed setup WNS improved to -0.915 ns and hold slack to 0.096 ns, but setup still fails. The reported critical path reaches `out_data[7]` through the read-pointer-selected memory output and I/O pad. The advisor’s separate output-register trial reached -0.199 ns WNS but remained infeasible and moved the critical path to `out_valid`; it used a binary occupancy counter, so it did not test output registers with iteration 1’s one-hot occupancy.

## Hypothesis

Register the FIFO head tuple at the output while retaining one-hot occupancy, reducing the read-mux-to-pad delay and avoiding the binary-counter path seen in the advisor trial.

## Instruction for generator

In `packet_fifo_core`, replace `out_data = data_mem[read_ptr]` and `out_last = last_mem[read_ptr]` with registered head outputs: load the input tuple when pushing into an empty FIFO, and on a pop with more than one queued tuple, load the next stored tuple; for a simultaneous pop and push at occupancy one, load the incoming tuple as the new head. Hold the head registers during stalls, preserve the existing one-hot occupancy and pointer wrap logic, and handle `DEPTH=1` explicitly; keep the top interface and `// @latency 1` annotation unchanged.
